notes: No test files deleted. Declaration prefixes come from the before-edit inventory; parameterized families expand into several real tests.
Retired specialty/image/dev positives are replaced by strict rejection and private-state proofs, not compatibility APIs.
A scrollable current text page permits public status label wrapping; exact selection-only position, same element/copy dimensions/order and nooverflow are retained.

private_retirement.test_search: retired $type cannot install private fields, buffer a replay or grant authority
private_retirement.reason: Retired private-hand/power messages are strict rejection cases; no timer, alternate hand or buffered replay remains.

ready.test_search: Ready acknowledgement alone never fabricates readiness or a phase change
ready.reason: Server Ready seats and matching complete state own readiness.

round.test_search: new round atomically replaces hand, prior ballot, Ready and phase deadline
round.reason: A complete new-round snapshot replaces these fields together.

reconnect.test_search: background erases private state and resume reclaims same seat without retrying move
reconnect.reason: All five modes clear private state and reclaim same room/seat with fresh epoch; no automatic intent replay.

rematch.test_search: verdict $mode choice is explicit and leave erases match before new admission
rematch.reason: Same table sends rematch {}; new table explicitly leaves and uses a certified queue tuple.

draw.test_search: $kind changes the hand only when the authoritative complete snapshot arrives
draw.reason: Draw adds owned copies; public evidence contains drawer/count without drawn card identity. Play/timeout remove only from a complete snapshot.

move.test_search: atomic move carries exact evidence and never spends optimistically
move.reason: All five mode payloads bind copy/revision/phase; duplicate pending confirmation cannot emit another request; explicit retry reuses original immutable request.

vote_error.test_search: correlated $code preserves or clears only its exact pending ballot
vote_error.reason: Matching request/error plus cursor decides pending intent; unrelated rejection cannot release it.

result.test_search: resolved ballot and revealed role arrive only from the server result
result.reason: Runoff candidates, voters and revealed role are authoritative.

clock.test_search: deadline is server-owned and expiry never emits an auto-play
clock.reason: All five modes reject locally expired actions without changing original deadline or hand.

missing_clock.test_search: a phase missing its mandatory deadline cannot preserve an old countdown
missing_clock.reason: V2 deadlines are required; incomplete phase payloads fail closed instead of merging legacy partial events.

deadline_merge.test_search: $phase retains original deadline and history through unrelated seat updates
deadline_merge.reason: Discussion, ballot and result snapshots retain exact original deadline.

handshake.test_search: handshake waits for credentials and sends no role override or queue implicitly
handshake.reason: Credential completion precedes hello; development role picking is retired.

auth_retry.test_search: rejected handshake requires explicit retry without creating or queuing an identity
auth_retry.reason: Rejected hello does not self-loop; explicit resume loads credentials again.

offline.test_search: unavailable credentials clear authority and public AppConfig still initializes
offline.reason: Offline public initialization never fabricates replacement identity.

selection.test_search: selection stays local until explicit confirmation and cancellation sends nothing
selection.reason: Selection/cancel is local. Off-turn controls are unavailable and a new turn never auto-plays.

selection_ui.test_search: $input selection and confirm send exactly one current copy and no optimistic spend
selection_ui.reason: Actual TextSession receives one explicit touch/keyboard/semantics confirmation and preserves hand until server state.

copy_stability.test_search: stable copies retain identity and selection through seat update and rotation at $width
copy_stability.reason: Exact position is retained on selection alone. Public status wrapping may move the scrollable page, while element/dimensions/order/selection survive; no overflow at360px.

evidence_selection.test_search: public evidence preserves hand order but invalidates stale board selection at $width
evidence_selection.reason: New board revision deliberately invalidates stale action preview without replacing retained hand copies.

new_selection.test_search: next round clears stale local selection while retained copies stay readable
new_selection.reason: New round/phase clears local preview while hand IDs remain authoritative.

sizing.test_search: $name $players seats at $viewport keeps every retained card and board reachable
sizing.reason: Five modes,4/6seats,320/430/834/1440 widths use current scrollable text surfaces; old workspace tabs/two-column/image-inspector assumptions are retired.

large_text.reason: All five modes plus ballot/result/verdict remain bounded with Arabic/pseudo2x text and48dp controls.

role_ui.test_search: role seal has no concealed semantics and keeps footprint while held
role_ui.reason: Held role disclosure has exact footprint and no hidden semantics.

spectator.test_search: $name never mounts private Nown or an unauthorized active hand
spectator.reason: Donower and eliminated projections do not install Nown; eliminated player has no role/hand/active controls.

background.test_search: background drops private hand, role, focus and pending selection before resume
background.reason: Private widgets and semantics disappear before reconnect; same role state returns without local preview.

ballot_ui.test_search: runoff uses only server candidates and pending vote prevents duplicate click
ballot_ui.reason: Exact target seat is sent; pending intent disables repeated clicks.

result_ui.test_search: result animation finishes without inventing role until server reveal boundary
result_ui.reason: A completed animation never reveals early; fresh server boundary exposes stationary poster.

verdict_ui.test_search: verdict exposes only begun Nowns and explicit same-table rematch
verdict_ui.reason: Only begun Nowns/finalscores and explicit rematch are exposed.

authored.test_search: long authored text remains complete and reachable at enlarged phone scale
authored.reason: Full text is directly readable in current hand; no old media inspector needed.

attribution.test_search: $size attributed public table cards retain exact seat and chronological history
attribution.reason: All4/6public cards retain seat attribution and chronological evidence; old newest-round table reorder is replaced by explicit evidence sequence.

round_zero.test_search: round one is explicit and a zero-round snapshot cannot replace evidence
round_zero.reason: V2 rounds start at1; invalid round0 must reject instead of legacy display adjustment.

media_refusal.test_search: obsolete $field playable metadata never mounts media or private content
media_refusal.reason: Legacy asset/type/URL fields fail closed without Image/playback.

share.test_search: lobby QR and clipboard agree on the actual app route web=$web
share.reason: Preserved rendered QR byte comparison against copied native/web join URL; actual TextPlay lobby now mounts same shared widget.

quick_chat.test_search: quick chat retains protocol IDs, localized labels and fallback
quick_chat.reason: All four locales retain stable phrase IDs and fallback.

poke.test_search: poke excludes self, eliminated and disconnected; chat trims and ignores empty
poke.reason: Current phase recipients only; empty chat emits nothing and valid authored chat carries locale.

poke_round.test_search: accepted poke suppresses the same phase group and resets on a new round
poke_round.reason: Same-round accepted evidence suppresses duplicate target; next round restores allowance.

retired_actions.test_search: retired Reveal and Shuffle cannot reveal another hand for $role
retired_actions.reason: Neither role may submit removed powers.

identity.test_search: wire seat identity never infers a bot or grants authority from a nickname
identity.reason: Strict public seat identity rejects nickname fields; no nickname-based synthetic eligibility.

role_override.test_search: role override and foreign-copy intent never cross current admission authority
role_override.reason: Client-selected role and foreign/extended copy payloads are rejected without mutation.

debug_retired.test_search: retired powers and roles cannot emit text intents in $name
debug_retired.reason: All five modes reject removed debug/specialty actions with no frame, state change or pendingrequest.

poke_feedback.test_search: targeted new poke shakes once and uses native haptics without replay
poke_feedback.reason: Actual server evidence triggers finite feedback; debug echo is retired.

snapshot_cache.test_search: stores only immutable verified text and preserves copy identity
snapshot_cache.reason: Deep immutable text cache replaces old image-byte LRU.

page_corrupt.test_search: rejects corrupted page bytes before installing any private state
page_corrupt.reason: Hash-invalid history cannot install partial role projection.

cache_budget.test_search: enforces configured frame and history budgets without partial install
cache_budget.reason: Protocol limits replace image-memory eviction budget.

cache_evict.test_search: verified page replay is stable and disconnect evicts all private data
cache_evict.reason: Replay rejection preserves complete baseline; disconnect clears private state and new epoch restores only authorized copies.

media_network.test_search: actual text page launch and reconnect never fetch playable media; corrupt=$corrupt
media_network.reason: Real TextPlay+ApiClient captured HTTP proves services are used but no catalog/asset URLs; valid reconnect or corrupt private media refusal.

cache_retirement.test_search: retires obsolete playable metadata without fetching
cache_retirement.reason: All exact old keys removed for text/image/GIF/future/corrupt/wrongtyped values; retained identity/preferences unchanged; HttpOverrides prohibits refresh.

header.test_search: compact retained header action has a label and48dp target
header.reason: 48dp retained public header action and no debug launcher.

small_shell.test_search: small pseudo text shell stays usable without dev grants
small_shell.reason: 2x pseudo small shell keeps real action reachable without debug controls.

countdown_label.test_search: compact countdown keeps its full accessible time label
countdown_label.reason: Exact original accessibility countdown assertion retained.

countdown_frozen.test_search: countdown holds frozen display then catches up on resume
countdown_frozen.reason: Exact original display-only countdown assertion retained.

finite_poke.test_search: poke feedback is finite and keeps layout stable reduced=$reduced
finite_poke.reason: Original finite/reduced-motion feedback assertions retained after shared-widget extraction.

request_budget.test_search: negotiated mutation budget survives phase changes and reconnect
request_budget.reason: Hello-negotiated immutable request cap is retained across phases and reconnect; no omitted field resets it.
